stories.title: Waianapanapa State Park Beach closed due to large surf, dangerous riptides
stories.summary: The Department of Land and Natural Resources Division of State Parks Maui Branch has announced the closure of the beach at Waiʻānapanapa State Park due to large surf and riptide conditions.

stories.title: Atlantis Adventures vessel runs aground at Waikiki’s Fort DeRussy Beach
stories.summary: The Department of Land and Natural Resources Division of Boating and Ocean Recreation is removing a 65-foot passenger vessel from the sandy shoreline at Fort DeRussey Beach in Waikīkī.

stories.title: Pounding waves tear apart fishing pier in Virginia Beach
stories.summary: Pounding waves tore apart a piece of a fishing pier in Virginia Beach, Virginia, Thursday.

stories.title: How to request Hawaii government records
stories.summary: The Office of Information Practices if offering tips for making record requests under Hawai`i’s public records law.

stories.title: Multiple snowboarders involved in brawl while waiting in lift line
stories.summary: A brawl broke out in a lift line at a ski resort in Vermont over the weekend.

stories.title: Invasive varroa mites found in feral bee colony on Kauai, next steps
stories.summary: The Hawaiʻi Department of Agriculture and Biosecurity and all its partners are taking steps in dealing with the discovery of varroa mites in a feral bee colony on Kauaʻi Nov. 9.

stories.title: U.S. Botanic Garden opens annual holiday show
stories.summary: The U.S. Botanic Garden’s (USBG) 2026 holiday exhibit features 37 models of national parks and historic places, each made entirely of plant parts.

stories.title: First Alert Forecast: Lingering showers from front with cooler temperatures for Thanksgiving Day
stories.summary: Scattered showers will affect mainly northern-facing slopes of the islands.

stories.title: 1 killed, 6 others shot during pajama party early on Thanksgiving, sheriff says
stories.summary: One person was killed and six others were injured in a shooting at a teenage birthday party at a Davenport, Florida, Airbnb, the sheriff said.

stories.title: EPA says air monitors detected no lead after Iowa explosives blast; lab results still pending
stories.summary: EPA monitors detected no airborne lead after the Army’s lead azide blast in Middletown, Iowa. Lab results for soil, water and dust are pending.

stories.title: Thanksgiving text mix-up friendship could become Lifetime movie
stories.summary: Wanda Dench and Jamal Hinton say Lifetime is working on a movie about their friendship, which began with a wrong-number Thanksgiving invitation in 2016.

stories.title: How to avoid AI scams while holiday shopping
stories.summary: Scammers are using AI to make fake emails, texts and voices sound real. A Virginia Credit Union expert shares steps holiday shoppers can take.
